run_load_data_to_mephisto_db: run the interactive script to load annotation data into the MephistoDB using mock requesters and workers
create_mock_requester: create a new MockRequester in the MephistoDB for use with mock task runs
create_mock_worker: create a new MockWorker in the MephistoDB to simulate workers on mock tasks
create_mock_agent_and_complete_assignmen: create a MockAgent for a unit, set inputs and outputs, mark done, and update status to completed
browse_mephisto_db_data: use MephistoDataBrowser to retrieve units and their data for a given task name from the MephistoDB
